{"script":"set -euo pipefail
ws=temp_workspace
mkdir -p "$ws"
# produce a raw recursive listing of paths under /working
if [ -d /working ]; then
  find /working -print > "$ws/listing.raw"
else
  : > "$ws/listing.raw"
fi
# extract entries whose basename is "workspace"
awk -F/ '$NF=="workspace"{print}' "$ws/listing.raw" > "$ws/matches.paths"
# create matches.txt with full path plus basic metadata for confirmed regular files only
: > "$ws/matches.txt"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  # confirm it's a regular file
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    # record full path and basic metadata: type|size|perm|mtime (unix epoch)
    stat -c '%n|%F|%s|%A|%Y' -- "$p" >> "$ws/matches.txt" || true
  fi
done < "$ws/matches.paths"
# produce status.txt
if [ -s "$ws/matches.txt" ]; then
  echo found > "$ws/status.txt"
  echo yes
else
  echo not_found > "$ws/status.txt"
  echo no
fi
"}
